claims.text: Referents in subject position have a higher tendency to be pronominalized in subsequent sentences.
Pronouns are more frequently used for animate referents compared to inanimate ones, indicating a grammatical role related to animacy.
The grammatical role of the current mention is more important than that of the antecedent in predicting the choice of referential form.
